title: gui.perform
description: Act on one node of the attached application. click uses the action that control exposes: press, pick, show its menu, or set its selected value. write replaces the text in a field. nodeId is the stable id from a GUI snapshot.

action.description: Activate the node with the control's available action.

nodeId.description: Stable id of the node to act on.
Stable id of the field to write.

text.description: Text to place in the field.
